description.narrative: The project is implemented in North Macedonia. The main outcome area it contributes to is democracy and human rights. The main right holders are active citizens of Albanian and Macedonian ethnic groups. Through study circles, the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Community Center of Struga Municipality and Olof Palmes Internationella Center. The local partner organisation provides legal and administrative aid to citizens of Struga, as well as non-formal education for youth and support to civic and cultural initiatives. The project was supported by ABF Sdra Smland until 2023,Project ObjectiveTo create a platform for integration, inclusion and social change, a platform that makes it possible for citizens from different ethnical, cultural and socio-economic backgrounds to work together to make local social change. This means, when the target group are engaged together, by a bottom-up approach and a measure working plan, they will have new tools for making a social change on a local grassroot level. Intermediate objective 1: Strengthening the local CSOs capacities to involve and engage citizens and to play a part in building an active popular movement. Intermediate Objective 2: Increasing active participation in the community development and decision-making processes by creating platforms with idea workshops, study circles and networks meeting that create opportunities for citizens to make their voice heard.Actor groups--Decision-makers-- Local authorities: Mayor of Struga, heads of units in Struga Municipality, Councillors and head of Municipal council. --Actors in Cooperation-- Local CSOs Informal civic initiatives organisations active within Palme Center political priorities/topics that are important for their communities. --Rights holders-- Citizens (Albanian, Macedonian and other ethnic groups) that want to be active within Palme Center political priorities/topics that are important for their communities.
